answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 6924 Country: India Title: I want to know the meaning of my name simal ahmd. 2) do shafi's are bind to follow the qasar while travelling. Question: I want to know the meaning of my name simal ahmd. 2) do shafi's are bind to follow the qasar while travelling. Answer ID: 6924 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1320/1239=D/1429) In Misbahul Lughat, the word Simal ( ثمال ) means: sympathizer and generous. It is right name as per the meaning. (2) You should ask the question with any Shafe?i Aalim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
